title: state.json
description: Per-task run state at <root>/<item id>/state.json. Written atomically (tmp + os.replace, flock) by the runner and board.state; read by the server. Extra keys are tolerated so an older reader survives a newer writer.

session_id.description: Session of the stage now running or last run (resume target).

last_tag.description: Status tag parsed from the last final reply. Q or A means Needs you.

error.description: Non-null: the run stopped and says why (becomes needs.text).

note_body.description: The note text taken at Start (cut at 20 000 chars); the card body once the source note is rewritten or closed.

resume_at.description: paused_limit and paused_retry: when to resume.

retry_kind.description: Why a paused_retry run rests (DOCS-resilience.md): no internet, gateway unreachable, a signal killed the turn, a crash, the todo app unreachable, or another transient turn failure.

retry_reason.description: The text behind retry_kind (at most 120 characters).

route.description: Route of the latest turn (set after a turn ran): plan = Max subscription, credits = free API credits, free = OmniRoute's free models through claude-free (T2531).

free_unverified.description: A turn ran on the free route: the run ships only after a Claude live-check turn ended cleanly (runner/freeverify.py). Absent otherwise.

tier.description: Decided at the first implement-role turn: cheap = the note has a `Tier: cheap` line or the text-free (textgate-rework) title, so Sonnet manages free models (DOCS-tiers.md).

free_models.description: The server's verdict before the latest cheap implement turn: public repo and a live gateway.

escalated.description: A cheap run handed over to Opus (ESCALATE line or a failed turn); at most once per run.

escalate_reason.description: Why it escalated, at most 300 characters.

model_pin.description: kuhy's model for this card (a model note or the picker; modelswitch): every turn runs it, over the role, tier and escalation models, until he names another or `default`.

ticket_model.description: Set before each turn while the run's open parts are all other apps' error reports (repotask/ticketmodel.py, T2582): Sonnet 5.5 on every route, below model_pin.

last_model.description: The model the latest turn ran on (the card's `model` when nothing is pinned).

credit_downgrade.description: Roles whose latest turn ran on a smaller model than they want because the credits route runs every role on the `credits_model` setting (default Opus 5.5): role -> wanted and ran. Absent when none.

auto_ship.description: Ticked at Start/Restart: a done_check note ships itself (checks -> shipping) once every check is green.

app_error.description: Set when the errors loop started the card (DOCS-errors.md): why it may start, the ticket keys on it. Such a run answers to no one and ships itself when green.

tokenopt.description: Set when the reset watch started the card (DOCS-credits.md, token optimization): the reset instant its note is keyed by. Such a run goes first in the queue, answers to no one, ships itself when green and gets the <run>/claude-wt worktree of ~/.claude; the next cycle drops it.

phone_update.description: A failed deploy waits for the phone (status waiting_phone_update): when it began and which try this is.

phone_tries.description: How many phone waits this cycle had; the watcher gives up after five.

repotask.description: The run is a repo task's (DOCS-repotask.md): its id is the repo's, its parts are the repo's open sections.

repotask_title.description: The repo task's card title, kept for its Done card.

cycle.description: Repo task only: which cycle the run is in; a shipped cycle that left parts open is followed by the next on Start.

cycle_at.description: Repo task only: when the current cycle started; the card shows only its stages and peer rows (T2479).

cycle_seq.description: Repo task only: the newest activity seq of the earlier cycles; no feed shows it or anything older.

cycle_cost.description: Repo task only: what the earlier cycles cost; the card shows cost_usd minus it.

sessions.description: Per role (spec, plan, implement, live_check, manager): session id and when its last turn ended (fresh session after 1 h idle).

context_tokens.description: The session's context at the latest assistant message of its last turn: input + cache creation + cache read tokens, the main thread only (DOCS-turns.md, Context cap).

ctx_reseeds.description: How often the context cap (TODOIMPL_CTX_CAP) cut a role's session and its next turn started fresh from the handoff summary: role -> count. Absent until a cut.

umbrella.description: Umbrella run record (DOCS-umbrella.md): width of the next round, kids in ease order, finished rounds, the round in progress. Child run states live in children/<id>/state.json.

auto_start.description: Set on a closing run (started by a passing done_check, no worktree); kept after Close.
